fusions.name: Spun Snare
fusions.desc: Casts a strand that deals 4 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, and slows what it hits by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Web Burst
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 10 damage, is stunned for 1.2 seconds and is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropline
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises by 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Respun Strand
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds within 4.5 tiles. Its hits apply poison, dealing 2 damage per tick for 4 ticks, and critically hit anything already afflicted.
